export.title: Export
export.ownHand: Yi writes this one itself: no pandoc needed.
export.configNew: Written there on your first export: {path}
export.replaceQuestion: Replace your copy of {path} with the one this build ships? Anything you changed in it is lost.
export.noPandoc: pandoc was not found on this machine, so this kind of export cannot run.
export.fontHint: No font in the conversion settings draws these characters: {characters} — name one there (`mainfont:` covers any script).
export.fontHintFont: No font in the conversion settings draws these characters: {characters} — add `mainfont: "{font}"` and `CJKmainfont: "{font}"` there; that font is the widest this machine is known to have, and both lines are needed because the CJK one is what Hangul is set with.
export.noTarget: Type the path the file should be written to.
export.pictureNotFetched: The picture at {url} could not be fetched, so the document names it instead.
version.title: Version this workspace with Git?
version.consent: Yi can keep a version of the note you are writing — but only when you ask for one. The versions stay in a git repository on this machine, and nothing is ever pushed anywhere.
version.risk: A cloud drive could reach this folder, so Yi will keep the repository outside it, here:
version.riskTheirs: A cloud drive could reach this folder. The versions will go into the repository you already have, and the drive will sync them:
version.declined: You said no to versions in this workspace. Turn them on under Settings → General if you want them.
version.noWorkspace: There is no workspace to keep versions of.
version.noGit: This machine has no git to run, so no version can be kept.
version.noFile: This note has no file yet. Save it first, and then ask for a version.
version.comment.title: Save a Version
version.comment.label: A note about this version (optional)
version.noRepository: No versions yet in this workspace
version.empty: No versions of this note yet
version.unreadable: The versions of this note could not be read.
version.diff.none: This version is what you have now.
version.restore.title: Restore this version?
version.restore.message: The note on screen and its file will hold the version of {stamp}. Nothing is committed: your next version is still yours to ask for.
version.restore.unversioned: What is on screen is not in a version yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.general.description: Where the app keeps things it takes from the system.
settings.general.languageHint: Changing the language reloads the window.
settings.general.pushUnstacked: Push the open document to the stack
settings.general.pushUnstackedHint: When you open a file and the document on screen has changes its file does not, push it to the stack instead of asking. A document already saved is replaced without a question.
settings.general.versioning: Keep versions of this workspace with Git
settings.general.versioningHint: A version happens only when you ask for one: File → Save a Version. Nothing is pushed anywhere.
settings.general.versioningNoGit: This machine has no git to run, so versions cannot be kept here.
settings.general.imageFolderHint: Where an image you insert is saved. Left empty, it is saved beside the note.
settings.citation.description: Configure how citations are formatted. Keys missing from the bibliography stay as typed.
settings.citation.fileHint: Optional. A CSL-JSON (Zotero) export or BibTeX file.
settings.citation.styleHint: Optional. A style bundled with citation-js; empty defaults to APA.
settings.newNote.description: The frontmatter a new note starts from. title, date, id and keywords are required: the app stamps the date and the id, fills the other two in when they are missing, and keeps every other line as you write it.
settings.newNote.templateHint: Written without the --- fences: the app puts them around it. Cleared, the app's own template is used again.
workspace.setup.title: Your workspace
workspace.setup.message: Yi keeps your notes in a folder. Make one, or open a folder you already have.
workspace.setup.where: A new workspace will be made in {folder}.
workspace.setup.noDocuments: The app could not find your Documents folder. Open a folder you already have with File → Open Folder…
